title: Service window
idea: Service window: Purpose and actual service limits lead into a prominent permitted contact action, with alternatives underneath.
audience: People who need to request service within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: The visitor needs one service action quickly and safely.
avoidWhen: A dramatic availability badge would imply unverified readiness.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic signal layout through its request service priority and explicit commitment contract: Only report request submission after an authoritative acknowledgement.
navigation: Service window keeps the current request service context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Purpose and actual service limits lead into a prominent permitted contact action, with alternatives underneath.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to request service; the visitor needs one service action quickly and safely.
composition.priority: Only report request submission after an authoritative acknowledgement.

imagery.role: Support the actual request service context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep the contact action reachable with enlarged text and preserve safety explanations.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the service window structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no request service content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Only report request submission after an authoritative acknowledgement.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized request service content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Only report request submission after an authoritative acknowledgement.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active request service context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
